subject: Orion Health: Evidence deliverables for onboarding (subprocessors + CAIQ mapping)
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@orionhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: security@orionhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding evidence request - subprocessor list + CAIQ mapping

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the team at Orion Health is excited to move forward. As part of our procurement gate we need a short evidence package to complete our security review. Can you please provide the following by EOD next Tuesday (2027-06-29):

1) A complete subprocessor inventory CSV (name, function, region of residency, data classes accessed, encryption at rest location).
2) A mapping of CAIQ control questions where Redwood's implementation is the control owner vs. shared vs. customer-responsibility (ideally in the template attached).
3) Short SOC 2 summary (scope, exclusions, most recent test period) and any gap notes.
4) Notes on ephemeral key handling and KMS ownership for customer-specific keys (we host keys in customer-managed KMS for our private option; need the flow for dedicated vs hosted).

I've attached our RFI template (Orion_RFI_Template.xlsx) — filling the highlighted columns will speed review. If any of these need more time, let me know which items and an alternate ETA. Also, feel free to redact contract-sensitive pricing or internal vendor contact emails.

Best,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Security Operations
Orion Health

Attachment: Orion_RFI_Template.xlsx
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding evidence request - Or. Action: owners and ETA

Laura / Grace — forwarding Orion's ask. Deadline 2027-06-29 EOD. Can we split this? My proposed split:

- Laura: subprocessor inventory + residency/export-control notes (they care about region of residency).
- Grace: CAIQ mapping + SOC2 summary (you can pull the one-pager from compliance docs and mark any exclusions).

Key points to call out in the inventory: edge cache/CDN providers, telemetry vendors (SaaS monitoring), KMS providers, and any partners with access to KV caches (we should list whether access is read-only or full KV). For ephemeral keys please include rotation cadence and whether keys are customer-managed for Dedicated/Private.

Please confirm owners and attach drafts by Monday morning so I can do one pass before sending to Emily. If either of you needs legal redaction support, loop in Laura (legal) — I can craft a minimal cover note.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Trust & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding evidence request - Or. Action: owners and ETA

Karthik — attaching the inventory draft. Highlights:

- Inventory contains 42 subprocessors (columns: vendor, role, residency, data classes, access scope, contact). Notable entries: FastEdge CDN (CDN/edge-cache, US/EU, reads cached tokens only), StreamLog (logging/telemetry, US, access to anonymized request metrics), KeyVaultCo (KMS for hosted customers, US-residency), CustomerKMS (customer-managed keys for Private/Dedicated deployments).
- Export-control: no restricted cryptographic exports expected; all vendor locales and residency fields populated.
- KV cache access: only runtime nodes have write access; no vendor has persistent key material.

I've also drafted CAIQ responses for the network/control sections with placeholders where legal review is required (see CAIQ_Draft_Response.md).

Attachments: RI_Subprocessor_Inventory_v2.xlsx, CAIQ_Draft_Response.md

If Grace can finalize the CAIQ matrix and SOC2 summary I can incorporate any redaction flags and then we'll send as a single package.

Laura Bennett
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emily Park <emily.park@orionhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding evidence request - package attached

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Attached is the package we discussed: RI_Subprocessor_Inventory_v2.xlsx (complete inventory), CAIQ_Responses_Orion.xlsx (control-owner mapping; redactions noted in column H), and SOC2_Summary.pdf (scope and test period).

Quick notes in-line:
- Customer KMS: for Private and Dedicated we support customer-managed keys. For Hosted we use KeyVaultCo; sidecar encryption is applied and we do not store key material.
- Ephemeral keys: runtime tokens are rotated every 15 minutes for workload short-lived sessions; long-lived service keys used by operators rotate on a 90-day cadence.
- Edge CDN: FastEdge only caches non-sensitive response fragments; we mark that in the inventory.

If you'd like, we can set up a 30-minute deep-dive with our compliance team tomorrow to walk the CAIQ mapping and answer any technical follow-ups. HubSpot link with the onboarding milestone is here: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/ORH-4521 — I'll update the milestone when you confirm receipt.

Thanks and looking forward to next steps,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Trust & Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_Subprocessor_Inventory_v2.xlsx; CAIQ_Responses_Orion.xlsx; SOC2_Summary.pdf
